title: CreeperFamily Music Mod
description: A music mod ONLY for CreeperFamily server
body:
NOTE: This mod is only made for a server called CreeperFamily which allows players to listen to music in CreeperFamily server, and it doesn't have any function if you are not playing in that server.

And this mod requires the latest Fabric Loader and Fabric API.
Only supports 26.1.2 and 1.21.11
